name: listGetDuplicates
description: Returns a list of the values that appear more than once in a list. Each repeated value is returned once, in the order of its first repeat.

params.name: delimiter
params.description: The delimiter. ColdFusion treats the whole string as one delimiter, so `;,` only splits on `;,`; Lucee treats each character as a delimiter. The result is joined with the full delimiter string.

params.name: ignoreCase
params.description: If true, values that differ only in case count as duplicates. The default is case-sensitive. Adobe's docs describe this argument the wrong way round.

params.name: includeEmptyFields
params.description: If true, empty elements are included, so a repeated empty element appears in the result as an empty item.

examples.title: Find duplicate values
examples.description: Returns each value that appears more than once.

examples.title: Ignore case
examples.description: With `ignoreCase` true, `one` and `ONE` count as duplicates.
